subject: [hw] V41 rev 5 update for review: 639/639; power lock + result-sized sync
body:
Small hardening after my DONE post; the acceptance command now prints 639/639 (600 per build config + 39 real-n2vcu) instead of 630. Please review this state (same files, no interface change):

1. ven_power_ref() now holds a per-session power_lock around the refcount + hw->power call, so an integrator's n2ap_venc_power() cannot race the daemon's POWER_ON/OFF handler. New test: 4 threads x 50 (on,off) rounds, TSan-clean, final refs 0.
2. The encode path's from_device sync now copies the reported result size, not the whole bitstream capacity, and the synchronous result lookup gained the same newest-nonzero-cookie fallback that wait_done already had (the vendor ring can echo a different cookie; with one job in flight this is the only completed entry).
3. Header notes that guest_unmap() on an entry register() created keeps it (the daemon's ion_munmap shares that path); guest_forget() releases it.

Re-verified: N2TEST V41 PASS 639/639; fakevenc/run_session.sh still produces the validated 115841-byte stream; host/run_vhost.sh the same. STATUS.md updated.
